afrexai-cleaning-business v1.0.0

- Initial release of cleaning business operations agent and reference guide
- Covers pricing, bidding, staffing, supply costs, insurance, OSHA compliance, and quality control
- Includes residential and commercial cleaning pricing tables and bidding formulas
- Provides benchmarks for staffing, supply budgets, insurance coverage, and operational KPIs
- Features growth playbook from solo operator to multi-crew business
